title: The Inner Circle
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'The Inner Circle,' Deangelo navigates office dynamics, attempts to assert authority, and faces suspicion about his intentions. The episode features humorous interactions, office conflicts over perceptions of sexism, and a chaotic dunking contest that results in Deangelo's injury, highlighting tensions and humor within the office.
